occupied_voice_answer.lesson: Reserve one sustained contact; answer with free contacts rather than retriggering the held finger
occupied_voice_answer.chart: 祈 -我ら神祖と共に歩む者なり- AT
transfer_recipe: Choose allowed_fingers/hold_fingers explicitly; reserve hold head→tail plus intended recovery margin.
Map the answer to free contacts using measured rhythm, not uniform density fill.
Inspect world target and carrier path before treating local separation as physical separation.
caveats: Tuples are source-local timing/geometry; they do not identify instruments or prove ergonomics.
Other source lines and active holds may change available fingers.

true_rest_after_tails.lesson: Head-free is not contact-free: stage line movement only after real release
observations: Holds on lines 2/3/7/6 remain until 106.206897 s; true all-contact rest starts there, not at last head.
transfer_recipe: Compute maximum active hold tail and connected-drag end across carriers.
Use release→pickup for main-anchor migration/decorative exposition.
Settle before the next approach; retain one main playing locus and annotate rest evidence.
caveats: Rounded display times; full exact source records remain optional.
No reaction-time allowance or human recovery claim is inferred from duration alone.

reprise_gesture_substitution.lesson: Develop a recognizable phrase by changing articulation/occupancy while retaining a legible frame
observations: Earlier 94–114 s staged geometry/held-tile section contrasts with 128–144 s finale.
Finale 128–144 s has 221 heads:198 tap/14 hold/9 flick;136–140 s favors discrete attacks,142 s adds visible release articulation.
transfer_recipe: First establish a rhythmic cell and hand relation from your own music evidence.
On its return, change sustained duration, answering ownership or selected release gesture instead of merely multiplying notes.
Resolve elaborate presentation toward regular geometry as discrete coordination becomes harder.
caveats: Study verifies sectional contrast, not a note-for-note musical reprise; audio/motif identity must be corroborated separately.
Reference has upper/lower/carrier relationships:49 selected finale heads flagged off-axis; do not copy those as regular default.

At 142.702703 s carrier 3 hold targets approximately(-262.5,-227.8125), on the ordinary row.
Source 24 engine lines includes 10 globally empty 10–19; engine count is not gameplay-axis count.
transfer_recipe: Retain line_id/local x/side/rotation and evaluate movement at judgment.
Project transformed target onto declared main-anchor tangent; flag unresolved remapping rather than stack local x.
Use hidden one-note carriers for approach motion that converges coherently; holds stay stable through tail.

terminal_length_duration.lesson: A huge approaching bar can be a short held object; visual length is not sustained-contact duration
observations: Twoordinary line 0 holds 143.783784→144.864865 s, then no heads until 149.189189 s.
Fourterminal carrier holds arrive 149.189189 s: duration 0.067568 s, speed 80, local x 0; transformedheadsall coincide atcenter.
Rotations 90/180/270/360 degrees, opacity 0 atimpact; spectacular bars do not prove fourdistinct contacts.
transfer_recipe: Separate visual approach length/speed from exact hold duration in design evidence.
After ordinary contacts resolve, stage a pre-cued ending with empty lines around stable real sustained voices.
Do not manufacture fourterminalholds or opposing approaches to satisfy multifinger/style quotas.
caveats: Co-located runtime collection behavior requires actual renderer/gameplay verification.
Reference terminal four-direction flourish is an explicit special case, not normal generation grammar.

recent_lateral_cell.lesson: Compose repeatable lateral relations with gaps; global fast spacing is not same-finger retrigger spacing
observations: Selected 271 heads:98 tap/135 drag/5 hold/33 flick; all heads project onto main axis in this study.
At 116.25→116.425781 s attack cell is outerleft→innerleft→outerleft→innerright; repeats 116.601562→116.777344 s.
Outerleft repeats 117.188 ms apart despite 58.594 ms global steps; cell gap matters.
transfer_recipe: Choose a small lane/order motif whose repeated-finger recovery can be explained.
Retain your own measured irregular beats; vary answer/exit on return.
Count connected drags separately from fresh attacks; show negative space after intensity.
caveats: Suggestedhand flow is a hypothesis; no hand anatomy/playtest proof.
